== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes prioritize martial professions when using this spell, but will cast it on any target if none are in range.

==Notes==
* If this skill and [[Clumsiness]] are active on the same target, both spells will trigger from the same attack.
{{anomaly|Skills which prevent interruptions will trigger when hexed with Wandering Eye but will not prevent their target from being interrupted nor from taking damage}}
{{anomaly|[[Miniature]]s seem to trigger the damage animation of this spell.}}

==Trivia==	 
* The [[Mesmer]] in the [[skill icon]] is wearing [[Mesmer Vabbian armor|Vabbian armor]], and is probably the same person that appears on skill icons of [[Waste Not, Want Not]] and [[Power Lock]].
